topLevel.why: X largely gives each separately titled story and essay its own part. Y repeatedly combines independent works, even placing Liberation Spectrum inside Human Readable while describing it in the following part's gist.

gists.why: Y has a slight advantage in distinguishing the developing conflict from the eventual breakup and in covering the responses to BIGMAC's spam; X better locates the hotel research and customs-queue passages. Most other paired gists are comparably useful.

weldedParts.why: Combines the title pages, contents, dedication, publication history, and correction note with the separately headed introduction.
Combines The Right Book and Other People's Money despite the first story's ending and afterword followed by a new story heading.
Includes the entirety of Liberation Spectrum after Human Readable's ending and afterword, crossing a clear story boundary.
Combines Visit the Sins, Constitutional Crisis, and Pester Power, three separately titled stories with their own endings and afterwords.

weldedParts.part: Vats, AIs, and the Business of Writing
weldedParts.why: Combines Chicken Little, Epoch, and Russell Galen's concluding essay, obscuring both story boundaries and the transition from fiction to nonfiction.

inventedClaims.what: The gist places the end of Trish and Rainer's romance in Progress pilgrims, whereas the subsequent Conflict of Insect division continues their relationship and contains their final separation.

overall.why: X's faithful story-by-story organization makes it substantially easier to navigate this collection. Y's slight advantage on the sampled gists does not compensate for hiding several independent works inside composite or misleadingly labeled parts.
